symbol_sample_rule: all rows where QD-001 symbol is numeric GEM prefix 300 and CY-006 normalized symbol is the same .SZ identity; no outcome-based sampling

price_tolerance.rule: within tolerance if every OHLC field satisfies absolute OR relative tolerance

turnover_tolerance: exact numeric equality in CNY amount; QD-001 amount maps to CY-006 amount
corporate_action_comparison_rule: compare availability of causal event/state fields; absence of QD-001 event identity is a failed equivalence gate, not an inferred no-event
calendar_rule: compare distinct normalized trade_date sets in the overlap; no missing date is filled
symbol_rule: normalize QD-001 six-digit numeric code to .SZ; reject any non-GEM or ambiguous identity
adjustment_rule: both must be raw/unadjusted; CY-006 causal rebasing must be explicitly represented or proven by an adapter
